facts.fact: The Director of Public Prosecutions said on 1 October 2026 that the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act No. 6 of 2022 provides the legal framework for offences committed through or against computer systems, and that her office has trained prosecutors on it.

note: No use fact: the DPP says her Directorate dealt with cases of illegal access and data and system interference and guided search and seizure under the Act, but gives no date, count, defendant or period.
